[D3:9] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a crowded convention hall with a large crowd of people

[D3:11] John: I played my favorite CS:GO game in an intense tournament. It was awesome to see all the skilled players competing.

[D3:13] John: It was indeed amazing! Watching those skilled players really inspired me to improve my own gaming skills.
[D3:14] James: Nice one, John! Learning from experienced gamers can really help you level up your skills. Keep it up!
[D3:15] John: I'm always looking to up my game and hit new goals. That same commitment is true for my hobbies and other stuff. What have you been doing to stay motivated?

[D3:17] John: Nice one! Setting small goals and tracking progress is a great way to stay motivated - it helps you stay on track and celebrates progress. Anything specific you're working on or upcoming challenges you're pumped about?
[D3:18] James: I'm getting into different types of games now, like RPGs and strategy games. It's really exciting!
[D3:19] John: Cool, James! That sounds exciting. Have fun exploring different genres of games!
[D3:20] James:  I'm super hyped to explore different game genres. Let's see what's in store!
[D3:21] John: Definitely! Trying new genres is always exciting. I can't wait to hear about your journey with them. Please let me know how it goes!
[D3:22] James: Got it, John! I'll keep you updated on my gaming adventures with the new genres. Have a good day!
[D3:23] John: Thanks! Can't wait to hear about it. Bye!
Session date: 2:13 pm on 4 April, 2022
[D4:1] John: Hey James! Long time no chat. What's up? Been playing any new games lately?

[D4:8] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a man sitting in a chair playing a video game

[D4:15] John: Sounds like a good plan. It really helps with communication. What game do you like playing with your team?
[D4:16] James: I've been playing my favourite game called Apex Legends with my team and it's intense! Check out this screenshot of us playing!
[D4:16] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a video game screen showing a robot and a robot
[D4:17] John: Man, Apex Legends looks tough! The graphics are unreal. How does it stack up against other games?
[D4:18] James: Apex Legends has awesome graphics and super fast-paced gameplay. It definitely stands out among other games.
[D4:19] John: Hmm, the speed of it definitely makes it fun! Are there any new games that you're looking forward to trying out?
[D4:20] James: Yeah, I'm always excited to try new games. Thinking of trying RPGs like that or MOBAs. Sounds cool!
[D4:20] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a video game cover of a video game
[D4:21] John: RPGs and MOBAs can be awesome to experience an engaging story or have epic multiplayer fights. Let me know how you like them!

Session date: 9:49 am on 22 July, 2022
[D17:1] John: Hi James! I just started playing chess to get better at strategy. I'm loving it! Have you ever tried it out?

[D17:3] John: Yeah, chess is really fun! It's like solving an endless puzzle and always trying to outwit your opponent.
[D17:4] James: Yeah, it's tough, but fun when you figure it out. Do you play with friends or online?
[D17:5] John: I'm playing mostly online for now, but I also joined a chess club and practice with others. Here's a pic from an intense game I played lately.
[D17:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a chess board with a laptop on it
[D17:6] James: Wow, looks intense! What sparked your interest in chess?
[D17:7] John: I've always been drawn to strategy games and wanted to challenge myself. Plus, I believe chess can improve decision-making skills.

[D17:10] James: Definitely! Studying opening moves and strategies and analyzing your games to spot weaknesses are great ways to improve.
[D17:11] John:  I'll definitely look into that. Appreciate the advice!
[D17:12] James: No worries, John! Happy to help. Just let me know if there's anything else I can assist you with.
[D17:13] John:  Your support means a lot to me. You're a true friend! Remember this photo from elementary school?
[D17:13] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of children holding a skateboard
[D17:14] James: That looks fun. But I don’t remember at all under what circumstances we took this picture. What's the story behind it?
[D17:15] John: This is from when we were 10 and we were really into skateboarding. We had a group of friends who often go to the skate park with. We would help each other learn new tricks and have a great time. Those friends made the experience even better and their friendship meant a lot to us.

[D17:16] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a small dog standing on a skateboard

[D17:19] John: Wow, that's great! Keeping active and happy is great for both of you.
[D17:20] James: Yep! Staying active with them builds a strong bond and makes us both happy.
[D17:21] John: Yeah, the bond between us and our pets is amazing. They bring a lot of joy and love. It’s a pity that I don’t have pets, I’ll definitely get one someday. By the way, how was your trip?
[D17:21] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a cat laying on a bed with a stuffed animal
[D17:22] James: Everything went great! In addition, I even managed to get out to another country. The city of Nuuk, if you know. I stayed there quite a bit, but at least I had one more country to add to my bucket list!
[D17:23] John: This is awesome, James! Surely you brought a lot of impressions with you!
[D17:24] James: Certainly! And not only impressions, I also brought souvenirs. For both you and your Jill!
[D17:25] John: Thank you very much, Jill will be delighted!
[D17:26] James: You're welcome! By the way, look who came to see me!
[D17:26] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman and two dogs on a couch
[D17:27] John: Nice pic, James! Who are they?
[D17:28] James: That's my sister and my dogs. We were just chilling together yesterday, and they bring so much happiness to my life.
[D17:29] John: Wow, they look so happy! It's awesome that you get to spend time with your sister and your furry friends. The bond you have with them is really strong.
[D17:30] James: I'm blessed to have a close bond with my sister and our furry friends. We have a great time together, like a family!
[D17:31] John: Family and friends are really amazing, James. They show us so much love and joy. I'm grateful for the connection I have with my siblings. Things can be tough sometimes, but their support means everything to me.
[D17:32] James: Fully agreed! My sister and I were also near the ocean and watched such a wonderful sunset!
[D17:32] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person walking on the beach with a surfboard
[D17:33] John: Wonderful photo! It's amazing how you can capture a moment and capture it in a photograph.
[D17:34] James: Thanks, John! This is just a good shot, nothing more. I took a lot of shots yesterday and chose the best one to send to you.
[D17:35] John: Still, the photo is amazing!
[D17:36] James: I have to go, I'm tired over the last two days. Bye!
[D17:37] John: Take care, bye!

Session date: 5:00 pm on 11 May, 2022
[D11:1] John: Hey James, it's been a bit since we last talked. Something cool happened recently - I volunteered my programming skills for a social cause. It was cool to use my passion to do something good. I made a software tool for one charitable foundation which helped streamline their operations and make them run more smoothly. Seeing my skills making a real difference in the world was really rewarding.
[D11:2] James: Hey John! Glad to hear from you. It's awesome that you used your skills to make a difference. Bet it was cool to see it in action. Would love to hear more about it!
[D11:3] John: Previously, this foundation used paper records and all inventory was recorded manually. I made an application that structured their work, and now everything they need for inventory is in one application on their smartphone.
[D11:4] James: Wow John, that's awesome! Must feel great to be part of something so important. I would love to see any visual examples of the impact your software made.
[D11:5] John: Yeah, here's a screenshot of the system. It'll make tracking inventory, resources, and donations run smoother and generate reports for analysis. Feels great knowing my skills are making a real difference to them.
[D11:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a computer monitor showing the cpu performance of a computer
[D11:6] James: Wow John, that's awesome! What motivated you to create such an amazing system for them?
[D11:7] John: I was inspired by their passion for helping kids, so I wanted to contribute in any way I could. Plus, coding lets me challenge myself and expand my skills, so this was a great chance to do both. It's really rewarding to use my coding skills to make a difference.
[D11:8] James: That's really great, John! It's awesome how you blended your passion with a good cause. How did it affect you?
[D11:9] John: It showed me the power of tech to make positive changes, beyond just my own enjoyment. It gave me a real sense of purpose.
[D11:10] James: Discovering our passions is truly rewarding. How do you think this experience will impact your future plans?
[D11:11] John: This experience has given me a clearer sense of purpose and motivated me to use my programming skills to make a positive impact. I'm now considering volunteer roles and potentially a career in the non-profit sector.
[D11:12] James: That's really inspiring. Have you found any non-profit organizations that align with your values and passion for programming?
[D11:13] John: I haven’t found it yet, but to be honest I haven’t looked for it. I think it won’t be difficult for me to find the organization I need.
[D11:14] James: There are lots of places where you can show off your skills! I'm sure you'll find one that's perfect for you in making a difference.
[D11:15] John: I'll be happy to find a place where my skills and passions are a perfect match. I'm hoping to make a positive impact there.
[D11:16] James: I'm sure you'll find the right spot, John. Your skills and passions will be a great addition. Good luck!
[D11:17] John: Thanks, your encouragement means a lot.
[D11:18] James: I'm here for you. Good luck!

Session date: 3:47 pm on 17 March, 2022
[D1:1] John: Hey! Glad to finally talk to you. I want to ask you, what motivates you?

[D1:4] James: I'm totally into The Witcher 3 right now. The story and atmosphere are amazing. Have you tried it yet?

[D1:6] James: Programming is an awesome skill. I tried it out one in college and now it`s all my life. Good luck in the class! Do you have any coding experience?

[D1:8] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a computer screen showing a video game scene
[D1:9] John: That mod looks amazing! The graphics are awesome. What other programming languages have you worked with?
[D1:10] James: I haven’t worked with any other programming languages, but I hope to work in the future.
[D1:11] John: Maybe in the future we will develop mobile applications together? Do you like the idea?
[D1:12] James: It would be cool! For example, we could write some kind of application for dogs. By the way, my dogs.
[D1:12] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two dogs are tied to a fence with a leash
[D1:13] John: Aww, they're adorable! What are the names of your pets? And what are your plans for the app?
[D1:14] James: Max and Daisy. Will be actually cool to build an app for dog walking and pet care. The goal is to connect pet owners with reliable dog walkers and provide helpful information on pet care.
[D1:15] John: Sounds good, James! Bet that app would find a lot of buyers. What sets it apart from other existing apps?

[D1:18] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person holding a notebook with a list of things on it
[D1:19] John: What are you working on that has you feeling so accomplished?
[D1:20] James: I'm working on something I've wanted to do since I was a kid. Even as a child, I made some sketches of the main character. Back then I was just drawing comics, but now I want to turn it into a computer game. It's a project that has me really excited.
[D1:20] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a drawing of a girl in a plane
[D1:21] John: Wow, James! That's amazing. What made you decide to work on it and create your own game?

[D1:23] John: That sounds really fulfilling! Combining your passions to make something new must be so exciting. Can't wait to see the outcome.
[D1:23] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a medical chart with instructions for the procedure

[D1:25] John: It will be great to work with you, James.
[D1:26] James: I'll be looking forward to it. By the way, yesterday I went bowling and got 2 strikes. I love bowling!
[D1:27] John: I'm sure you're very good at this. Unfortunately, I can’t share my love for him with you, my fingers are too big. Perhaps I should take up exercise, at least start going for a run in the morning. And I also don’t like bowling itself, to be honest.

[D1:31] John: I'm sorry to hear it. Well, I'll be nearby, I'll look after your pockets.

[D1:36] James: Yeah, VR gaming is awesome! Let`s do it next Saturday!
[D1:37] John: Agreed, James!
Session date: 9:26 pm on 20 March, 2022
[D2:1] James: Hey John, something awesome happened since we talked. I made a game avatar and joined a new platform. It's so fun exploring and chatting with other gamers - it's a whole new adventure every time! I feel like I'm part of a super cool online community.
[D2:2] John: Hey James, awesome! Glad you're enjoying it and connecting with others. Building a community is really cool, especially when you meet people who enjoy the same things.
[D2:3] James: Thanks, John! Connecting with other gamers has been great! We've shared tips, strategies, and stories about gaming. It's amazing how it brings people together, regardless of their backgrounds.
[D2:4] John: That's incredible! It's so cool how gaming can bring people together and create a strong bond, regardless of their background.
[D2:5] James: Yeah, it's our shared language and passion. It's been a refuge for me in tough times.
[D2:6] John: Yeah, gaming always helps me escape stress. It's amazing how it calms me down during tough times.
[D2:7] James: Games are my go-to when I'm feeling overwhelmed. It's like therapy. I can relax, forget my troubles, and get lost in another world.
[D2:8] John: Gotcha. Gaming can be a great way to take a break and escape for a while. Anything new you've been into lately?
[D2:9] James: Lately, I've been checking out different styles of it. It's been fun to try something fresh and test myself in other ways. What about you, John? Any new hobbies recently?
[D2:10] John: I've been getting into a new hobby recently. I bought a metal detector and walk along the beaches looking for something worthwhile.
[D2:11] James: Interesting, John! Sounds like an awesome immersive experience. Already found something interesting?
[D2:12] John: Mostly just bottle caps, but a couple of times I found coins, and once even a gold ring.
[D2:13] James: Cool, I wish you good luck in this matter! By the way, I've got something to show you.
[D2:14] John: Show me what you've got! What is it?
[D2:15] James: Check out this pic of my best buds having a blast in the park. They've brought so much joy to my life. My two dogs are the best pals ever, right?
[D2:15] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two dogs running in a field with a ball in their mouth
[D2:16] John: They look like they're having a blast! Can they do any tricks?

Session date: 5:20 pm on 5 November, 2022
[D30:9] James: Cool! It's all about studying the game to gain the edge. Do you have any tips for improving?
[D30:10] John: Yeah, studying opening moves and strategies can really help. It sets the tone and builds a strong foundation. Learning from experienced players and analyzing past games is important too. Plus the chess advice you gave me earlier also helped. Would you like some resources on chess openings?
[D30:11] James: Sure, I'd love to check out some resources on chess openings. Thank you!
[D30:12] John: I've got you covered on that. Here's a helpful resource for chess openings. Happy to help!
[D30:12] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a book with a list of the different games
[D30:13] James: Thanks for the suggestion, John. What games are you currently playing? I'm always looking for new recommendations.
[D30:14] John: I'm hooked on this great game called FIFA 23. This is a great football game with the ability to play online with other players from all over the world! Enjoy!
[D30:15] James: Wow, that sounds awesome! I just wanted to try a new gaming genre, so why not try the sports genre.
[D30:16] John: You need to practice a little first, and then we can play together.
[D30:17] James: Great idea! I hope it's easy to control.
[D30:18] John: Not at all, all you need is a gamepad and a sense of timing.
[D30:19] James: Great! Well, I'll go train!
Session date: 8:57 pm on 7 November, 2022
[D31:1] James: Hey John! Guess what? Me and my family are currently on the road trip! We`ve already visited my friends Josh and Mark and had such a great time!
[D31:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of people posing for a picture
[D31:2] John: Hey James! That sounds awesome! I had a super fun weekend - I worked with a game developer on a project and it was great to see my ideas come to life. It was an incredible experience! 
[D31:2] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a wooden board game with four pieces of wood and four pieces of colored balls
[D31:3] James: That sounds amazing. What was the project you worked on?
[D31:4] John: I collaborated with a game developer to create an online board game - it's a fun and unique experience!
[D31:5] James:  I can imagine how proud you must feel seeing your ideas come to life in a game. Has it been released for others to try yet?
[D31:6] John: We're about to release a demo soon so others can try it out. Can't wait for their feedback and suggestions.
[D31:7] James: Can't wait to try it. Keep me posted when it's out - I wanna support you and give my thoughts.
[D31:8] John: Appreciate your support. I'll definitely let you know when it's out and I'm really excited to hear your thoughts.
[D31:9] James: By the way, we did one good thing on the way to Mark and Josh.
[D31:10] John: What is this? Looking forward to hearing your story!
[D31:11] James: We visited an animal sanctuary on the road trip - there were so many cute rescue dogs! I thought of our love of furry pals.
[D31:11] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a man kneeling down next to a dog
[D31:12] John: Cool! What was it like visiting the animal sanctuary? Did you feel tempted to bring any furry pals home?
[D31:13] James: Those rescue dogs were so cute, I wanted to take them all home, but I remembered that I already have three dogs at home. I think having more than three dogs is too much.
[D31:14] John: You are right! I still haven’t gotten a dog, but I still really want one. What is it like to have a dog?
[D31:15] James: Having furry friends around brings so much joy and friendship. Life wouldn't be the same without them. Every day's better with them around.
[D31:16] John: Yep, they bring so much joy and love. They're always there for us! It's like having sunshine on a cloudy day.
[D31:17] James: My dogs are like that too - they even make dark days better. Don't know what I'd do without them. They're the best buddies.
[D31:18] John: Yeah, dogs are awesome for sure! They make us feel so loved and cheerful, don't they?
[D31:19] James: Yeah, they definitely do. Dogs always cheer us up, wagging their tails and giving us unconditional love. It's like having a dose of positivity and happiness every day. They're amazing!
[D31:20] John: Definitely, James! Dogs are amazing. They bring so much joy and positivity. They accept us without judgement, just love and happiness. I appreciate the daily dose of positivity they bring to my life. Special buddies for sure. By the way, here is my cousin's dog.
[D31:20] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a dog sitting on a rug in front of a couch
[D31:21] James: This pup is so adorable! What's their name?
[D31:22] John: Their name is Luna. 
[D31:22] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two people standing in front of a giant head
[D31:23] James: Luna's a great name!
[D31:24] John: Thanks, gonna go, sorry. Cheers! Bye!
[D31:25] James: Later! Take care!
